description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the /staff API in the Apache Fineract project. It defines the StaffTest class, which includes test methods for creating staff records and retrieving existing staff data, as well as utility methods to facilitate testing.

classes.name: StaffTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the Staff API, providing methods to create and retrieve staff data, with test cases for validation.

methods.name: createOne
methods.description: Test method that asserts the creation of a staff record results in an ID greater than zero.

methods.name: retrieveAnyExisting
methods.description: Test method that ensures at least one existing staff record can be retrieved.

methods.name: getStaffId
methods.description: Utility method that retrieves the first staff ID or creates a new staff member if none exist.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Utility method that creates a new staff record with randomized data and returns its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveFirst
methods.description: Utility method that retrieves the first staff record's ID if available.
